items.title: The tensor product of simple algebras, one of them finite and central
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the tensor product of two simple algebras over a field is simple, provided one of them is finite and central (statement lines 537-541). The proof is a complete argument: the finite central algebra is written as a matrix algebra over a finite skew field with center the ground field by the structure theorem, which reduces the claim to tensoring the other algebra with that skew field (proof lines 543-546); the cited lemma on two-sided ideals gives simplicity there, and the description as a matrix algebra over that simple algebra gives simplicity of the tensor product (proof lines 547-551). The non-formal content is the reduction to the skew field case. The claim is H2.
